notes: Initial inbound from CTO (call 2024-09-12) — interested in replacing in-house Triton stack to reduce ops burden; target: latency-sensitive personalization & chat.

Model preference: Llama-2 13B / quantized 4-bit for quality/cost tradeoff; willing to trial 8-bit/4-bit quant profiles; want Redwood Optimize recommendations for quant and batching.
